description: Player availability keeps changing because of school, work, illness, and family obligations, and the staff needs one reliable picture of who is actually available for which upcoming session. All team names are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 37-year-old assistant coach juggling lineups around constantly changing attendance
user_profile.context: Repeated verbal updates are creating conflicting assumptions about who will be present at training
user_profile.communication_style: Scheduling-focused and no-nonsense, wants availability captured in a way that prevents rechecking the same players

fact_sheet.fact: The team is named the 'River City Raptors'.
Liam Chen is a midfielder and wears jersey number 10.
Maria Garcia is a defender and wears jersey number 4.
Ben Carter is the goalkeeper and wears jersey number 1.
Olivia Jones is a forward and wears jersey number 9.
Sam Williams is a defender and wears jersey number 6.
Alex Riley is the Assistant Coach and is responsible for managing training session lineups.
Sarah Jenkins is the Head Coach and provides final approval on game-day rosters.
Training is scheduled for Tuesday, October 24th, 2023, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM at Northwood Field.
The next training session is on Thursday, October 26th, 2023, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM at Northwood Field.
A team meeting is scheduled for Saturday, October 28th, 2023, at 10:00 AM in the Crestview Community Center Room B.
Liam Chen has marked himself 'Unavailable' for the Oct 24th session due to a midterm exam at Riverbend University.
Maria Garcia is marked as 'Questionable' for the Oct 26th session; she is recovering from a mild ankle sprain.
Ben Carter has a recurring work conflict at his job at 'The Daily Grind Cafe' and is unavailable for all Thursday sessions, including Oct 26th.
Olivia Jones has confirmed her status as 'Available' for all sessions scheduled for the week of October 23rd.
Sam Williams has set his status to 'Late Arrival' for the Oct 24th session, noting an expected arrival time of 6:30 PM due to a family dinner.
Chloe Davis, jersey number 15, is 'Unavailable' for all team activities until October 30th due to influenza.
As of 11:00 AM on October 24th, 14 out of 18 players have confirmed their availability for that evening's session.
Maria Garcia notified Coach Riley via text at 9:15 AM that her attendance on Oct 26th depends on a physio assessment at 4:00 PM that day.
Liam Chen confirmed he is 'Available' for the Thursday, October 26th session.
Players are required to update their availability status in the 'TeamStatus Pro' app no later than 12:00 PM on the day of a training session.
Failure to update availability by the 12:00 PM deadline results in the player being marked 'Unavailable' by default.
Urgent, same-day availability changes must be communicated directly to Assistant Coach Alex Riley via the 'Raptors-Coaching' Slack channel.
Coach Alex Riley sends the final confirmed attendance list to Head Coach Jenkins via email at 5:00 PM on training days.
The team uses the 'TeamStatus Pro' mobile app for all official availability tracking.
The login URL for the team's 'TeamStatus Pro' portal is https://app.teamstatuspro.com/rivercityraptors.
The possible availability statuses in 'TeamStatus Pro' are 'Available', 'Unavailable', and 'Questionable'.
The 'TeamStatus Pro' app allows players to add a short note of up to 100 characters to explain their status.
An automated email reminder is sent from 'TeamStatus Pro' at 10:00 AM on session days to any player who has not yet updated their status.
The team manager, David Kim, is responsible for booking all training fields and meeting rooms.
